name: Kastelan Robot

bonuses.name: Battle Protocols
bonuses.text: By default, the Kastelan Robot's Aegis Protocol is active. As an Action, an individual with the Tech Skill can make a DN 10 Tech Test to change the Kastelan Robot's Battle Protocol. An individual with the Reprogrammer ability can make this Test as a Simple Action at DN 5. Aegis Protocol: The Kastelan Robot's Resilience increases to 20. Conqueror Protocol: The Kastelan Robot's Weapon Skill increases to 10 and it gains +2 bonus dice when it Charges. Protector Protocol: The Kastelan Robot's Speed is reduced to 0, its Ballistic Skill is increased by 2, and its Resilience is increased to 18.

bonuses.name: Robot
bonuses.text: This Threat is unaffected by abilities that target the mind, and never needs to make a Resolve Test to continue fighting. Additionally, this Threat is immune to the Bleeding, Blinded, Exhausted, Fear, Pinned, Poisoned, and Terror Conditions.

abilities.name: Dataslot Disruption
abilities.text: If the Kastelan Robot rolls a Complication or a Complication is rolled on a Tech Test targeting the Kastelan, roll 1d6. If the result is another Complication, the Kastelan Robot uses its next Action to move its Speed in a random direction as dictated by the Scattering rules (Wrath & Glory Rulebook, page 186) and attacks the nearest individual. If the result is not a Complication, the Kastelan Robot's Battle Protocol changes as determined by the GM. When a Complication is triggered, any character with the ADEPTUS MECHANICUS Keyword within 10m can attempt a DN 10 Tech Test to prevent this effect. This Tech Test is DN 5 for individuals with the Reprogrammer ability.

abilities.name: Explodes
abilities.text: When this Threat is destroyed, roll 1d6. If you roll a Complication, the Threat explodes with the following profile: 12 +6 ED / Blast (6).

determination: Repulsor Grid: Spend 1 Ruin to roll 10d6. Whenever this Threat rolls Determination against a ranged attack they may Shift Exalted Icons to deal 1 Mortal Wound to the attacker for every Exalted Icon Shifted.
note: Different printing from hat-kastelan-robot (not a reprint: that source is homebrew). Printed Resilience 16 has no bracketed note. Explosion has no printed range, kept as ability text.
